advanced.suppress_ack_help: Bus ACK. When checked, the telegrams sent to the KNX bus (Tunnel UDP, Multicast and Serial FT1.2) no longer ask the receiving devices for an acknowledgement. With Tunnel UDP and "Wait for the tunnelling ACK" set to Auto, the node also stops waiting for the interface's confirmation. Enable it only if your interface needs it, for example some old or Weinzierl KNX/IP interfaces, eibPORT and Loxone. Default is unchecked.
advanced.wait_tunneling_ack: Wait for the tunnelling ACK (Tunnel UDP)
advanced.wait_tunneling_ack_auto: Auto (only if the bus ACK request is not suppressed)
advanced.wait_tunneling_ack_help: Interface ACK. With Tunnel UDP, the node waits for the KNX/IP interface to confirm every telegram: a telegram that is not confirmed is sent once more, then the connection is closed and opened again. Auto waits only when "Suppress the bus ACK request" is unchecked, as in previous versions. Yes always waits, No never waits. eibPORT and Loxone gateways need "Suppress the bus ACK request" checked together with Yes.

file_cache.disabled_tip: Writing to disk is disabled (File Cache Control of the KNX gateway): at every restart of Node-RED, all the current GA values and the data saved by the KNX Ultimate nodes will be lost.
file_cache.description:
Sets how often KNX Ultimate writes its files to disk (GA values, Scene Controller scenes, AutoResponder values, Logger file, Viewer history), to reduce the wear of SD cards. Files are written only when their content has changed. The log is not affected: use the log level for it.
Freshness priority: changes are saved every 5 seconds.
Balanced: changes are saved only when the gateway connects or disconnects, and when Node-RED stops or the gateway is redeployed.
Disable writing: nothing is written to disk.
Custom interval: changes are saved at the chosen interval (5 seconds to 30 days), and when Node-RED stops or the gateway is redeployed.
